claim_policy.allowed: Associational comparisons: 'people with similar usage who are classified lower-risk typically have X lower by Y'.
claim_policy.forbidden: Causal or outcome claims: 'reducing X will lower your risk', or any statement about what happened to people after they changed behaviour. This dataset is cross-sectional - nobody was followed over time, so it contains no outcomes.

comparison_group: The low-risk subset of the user's nearest neighbours. Comparing against all neighbours would only describe people like the user; the informative contrast is with similar people who are nonetheless classified lower-risk.
